about.title: About us
about.lead: GazDream makes solid-fuel heat generators (PUT) from 100 kW to 20 MW that run on wood, agricultural and household waste with no fuel preparation.
about.tech: The gasification principle burns the raw material almost completely. CO in flue gas is below 0.1 g/m³, against the 0.6 g/m³ allowed for natural gas.
about.officeText: Kraksten, Warsaw. Consulting, quotes and customer support in Poland, Germany and the EU.

boilers.title: PUT heat generators
boilers.lead: A solid-fuel furnace with an air heat exchanger for drying grain, vegetables, fruit, herbs and timber.
boilers.fuel: Main fuel: wood chips, corn cobs.
includes: Temperature stabiliser lined with fireclay brick
Hot cyclone for burning out carbon residue
Stainless cyclone dust collector and spark arrestor
options: Integration with the plant control system, remote monitoring

projects.title: Projects
projects.featured: 5 MW heat generator upgrade for the “Ukraina-50” dryer
projects.featuredText: A new high-output burner, an automatic fuel feed and integration with the existing generator without replacing the heat exchanger. Operation became steadier and servicing simpler and safer.
